info.title: AL-Go for GitHub Control CLI
info.description: CLI for controlling AL-Go for GitHub repositories

commands.name: createrepo
commands.description: Create a new repository from a template repository

options.name: --templaterepo
options.description:
Template repository to copy content from.
Short form (owner/repo) defaults to github.com;
a full URL may target a GitHub Enterprise host.
Default: https://github.com/Freddy-DK/AL-Go-PTE

options.name: --templateghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for reading the
template repository. Default: the active account
on the template host, or unauthenticated if none.

options.name: --repo
options.description:
The repository to create. Short form defaults
to github.com. (required)

options.name: --ghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for creating the
repository. Default: the active account on the
target host.

options.name: --visibility
options.description:
Visibility of the new repository.
Default: private

commands.name: updaterepo
commands.description:
Update an existing repository's AL-Go system-file workflow and run it
--version, -v    Show the algoctl version

options.name: --templaterepo
options.description:
Template repository to copy the workflow from.
Short form (owner/repo) defaults to github.com;
a full URL may target a GitHub Enterprise host.
Default: https://github.com/Freddy-DK/AL-Go-PTE

options.name: --templateghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for reading the
template repository. Default: the active account
on the template host, or unauthenticated if none.

options.name: --repo
options.description:
The repository to update. Short form defaults
to github.com. (required)

options.name: --ghuser
options.description:
GitHub CLI account to use for updating the
repository. Default: the active account on the
target host.

options.name: --branches
options.description:
Comma-separated list of branches to update, passed
to the workflow's includeBranches input. Wildcards
are supported. Default: main
